remarks: Location, Location, Location!  This updated 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse is just minutes from the best of downtown Stamford-restaurants, bars, shopping, gyms, and more! Enjoy the convenience of walking to the Stamford Train Station, as well as nearby Scalzi and Mill River Parks.  The main level features a spacious living and dining area with gleaming hardwood floors and a wall of windows that fill the space with natural light. The eat-in kitchen includes stainless steel appliances and a cozy dining nook with a bright bay window. An updated half bath completes this level.  Upstairs, the large primary bedroom offers hardwood floors, an updated en-suite bath, and two oversized double closets. The second bedroom also features hardwood flooring, a bay window, and easy access to a full hall bathroom.  The finished lower level is ideal for a home office or additional living space, complete with in-unit laundry, access to a private patio, and entry to the attached one-car garage.  Additional amenities include a beautiful in-ground pool, guest parking and complimentary Wi-Fi.  Tenant must have excellent credit and references. One dog allowed (sorry, no cats).
